messages.content: Use the web fetch tool on each of these 14 URLs, one tool call per URL, one at a time, in order: https://httpbin.org/anything?n=1 , https://httpbin.org/anything?n=2 , https://httpbin.org/anything?n=3 , https://httpbin.org/anything?n=4 , https://httpbin.org/anything?n=5 , https://httpbin.org/anything?n=6 , https://httpbin.org/anything?n=7 , https://httpbin.org/anything?n=8 , https://httpbin.org/anything?n=9 , https://httpbin.org/anything?n=10 , https://httpbin.org/anything?n=11 , https://httpbin.org/anything?n=12 , https://httpbin.org/anything?n=13 , https://httpbin.org/anything?n=14 . After each fetch, write one line with the value of the "n" argument you saw. End with a line: REPORT fetches=<n>.
